messages.subject: Marwick response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Pemberton Rowe have responded denying liability. As expected they run two arguments: (1) the failures were your fault (misalignment / overloading / maintenance), and (2) clause 11 caps their liability to the unit price and excludes the Halcyon downtime damages.

We're confident on (1) given Paul's alignment and maintenance records and the Renshaw report. (2) is the real battleground - we think clause 11 is vulnerable under UCTA but it carries risk. I'd suggest we issue proceedings and instruct Harriet Stanford to advise on merits and on a sensible settlement range.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
